section.title: Introduction and Overview
section.p: This document is intentionally brief; refer to for information pertaining to the changes in the sprite system for colour mapping.

bitfield-table.bit: If set, a colour mapping function has been supplied. If clear, no colour mapping should be performed.

swi-definition.name: DrawFile_Render
swi-definition.description: Render a Draw file (changes for colour mapping)

entry.register-use: Flags (bit 3 indicates that a colour mapping descriptor is supplied in R6)
Pointer to draw file to render
Pointer to transform, or 0 for identity
Pointer to clipping box, or 0 for none

use.p: The flags are updated, and R6 is used if the colour mapping flag is set.
